clips.title: The story
paras: In northeastern Loch Modan, Mo'grosh ogres mine and hoard rare crystals with unusual alchemical properties. The crystals help dwarven engineers neutralize Dark Iron explosives.

The Mo'grosh ogres mine these crystals in their stronghold in northeastern Loch Modan. Though the ogres favor brute strength over delicate metallurgy, their clan prizes the stones. Common enforcers, mystic shamans, and towering leaders carry them. The crystals are uncommon, so the ogres guard them closely within the Mo'grosh Stronghold.
